notes:
Summary: Elmbridge RankWorks is an EU-headquartered knowledge platform for regulated professional services (legal + compliance). Primary ask: low-latency regional search across UK + EU zones with strong data residency controls and a reranking layer for precision. Targeting a multi-region architecture: primary EU (Frankfurt) + failover UK (London) with automatic routing and fast cross-region failover.

Scale & performance requirements:
- Index size: initial 80M vectors, expected growth to 180M within 12 months.
- Embedding dimension: 1536 (current transformer embeddings) but open to switching to 1024/768 for cost optimization.
- Query volume: baseline 200 qps with peak bursts to ~500 qps; steady-state 150k queries/day.
- Latency SLO: end-to-end search (ANN + top-K rerank) 60ms p95 EU region, reranker tail <= 45ms p95.
- Cost target: <$0.003 per user query (emb + ANN + rerank) or similar net unit economics to current Elastic cluster.

Technical preferences & architecture notes:
- Want embeddings stored in a managed vector store with local EU storage and UK partitioning for a subset of documents (data residency).
- Reranker: cross-encoder on GPU (prefer dedicated GPU pool) to re-score top-20 candidates. Consider batching for reranker to meet latency & cost targets.
- Fallbacks: prefer lightweight CPU-based fallback model for degraded capacity; Redwood routing to fall back to lower-cost model variant acceptable.
- Evaluation: using Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching and quantization; want RFC on model/quantization tradeoffs.

Security & compliance:
- Must support SSO/SAML with IdP metadata hosted in UK.
- SOC2 required by procurement; doing ISO/27001 gap analysis.
- Audit logs retained 1 year by default; legal wants 3-year retention option for specific data classes.
- Keys: require KMS integration + HSM option for private deployment.

Procurement & commercial:
- Procurement prefers 12-month committed Dedicated or Private contract. Initial ARR target: 100k-250k.
- Pricing sensitivity: they will benchmark cost-per-query vs current Elastic + CPU cluster.

Recent timeline (bulleted):
- 2025-12-04: Intro call (FF-2025-12-04-ELM-Call1) — demo of hosted API; customer emphasized UK residency.
- 2026-01-15: Security intake sent; legal asked for data residency proof points.

- 2026-03-05: Commercial refresh — procurement flagged need for explicit SLA for cross-region failover.

POC success criteria (agreed):
- Ingest 2M-doc sample, produce index, run 10k queries with representative distribution.
- Measure ANN recall@10 >= 0.88 and final reranked precision@5 improvement >= +12% vs baseline.
- End-to-end p95 latency <= 60ms in EU and <= 85ms in UK (accounting for cross-region calls).
- Cost projection report with per-query breakdown and three scenarios (hosted, dedicated, private).
